agents.result: `Tag.save` now only sets the slug and returns None, `tag_create` in `tags/views.py` was its only caller and has been updated, and all 3 tests pass; heads-up, the other engineer's planned one-expression `tag_slug` (e.g. `Tag(name).save().slug`) will break against this change unless it's rewritten to save first and then read `tag.slug`.

I added `tag_slug(name)` in `tags/utils.py` as the single expression `((tag := Tag(name)).save(), tag.slug)[1]`, which reads the slug from the tag rather than from `save()`'s return value, so it keeps working after the other engineer's change makes `save()` return `None`; all 3 tests pass, though none of them call `tag_slug` and I didn't run it separately.
